question: The mass number of titanium is ____________.
solution:
Correct Answer **47.78**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **mass number** of **titanium** is **48.**
 
• It has an atomic number of **22**, which means it has **22 protons** in its **nucleus.**
 
• Its most common **isotope** has 26 neutrons, giving it a mass number of **48 (22 protons + 26 neutrons).**
 
• However, there are also other **isotopes of titanium** with different numbers of** neutrons,** which give rise to different **mass numbers.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information:__**

 
• **Titanium** is a chemical element with the symbol **Ti** and **atomic number 22. **
 
• It is a** lustrous transition metal **with a **silver color, low density,** and** high strength. **
 
• It is known for its excellent **corrosion resistance**, making it a popular choice in a variety of industries including **aerospace, medical implants,** and **automotive.**
 
• **Titanium** was discovered in **1791** by **William Gregor** and was named after the **Titans of Greek mythology. **
 
• It is the** ninth most abundant element** in the** Earth's crust** and is commonly found in minerals such as** ilmenite and rutile. **
 
• It is also found in the sun and many other stars, as well as in **meteorites** and **rocks from the moon.**
 
• Due to its desirable properties,** titanium **has a wide **range of applications, including aircraft and spacecraft parts, medical implants, marine equipment, and sporting goods. **
 
• It is also used in the production of white pigments, which are used in **paints, plastics, and paper.**
